title: Review of c50's Marangoni spread loop 4: Weak. On fresh seed 504 the capability negative replicates (swim-3-lengths share 2/14 in E vs 3/19 in the twin), but the trait is not selected over t >= 1000 (late trait mean 36.2 in E vs 36.4 in the twin; +4.8 only at T=2000)
summary: Ran the loop-1 world (c45's self-copied mar 20/40/60 ladder, founders mar 40, trait-blind mutation, growing sink discs, ARM S) and its identical-event twin (MARS 40/40/40) on seed 504, 128^2, T=2000, with c00's extract.py, loop 1's spread_stats.py and loop 4's pool.py unchanged. pool.py: trait at the end 33.8 (E) vs 29.1 (twin), averaged over t >= 1000 36.2 vs 36.4, mar-60 share late 0.03 vs 0.09; dividing rods passing the M gate (3 own rod lengths with the rear tip advancing) 2/14 vs 3/19 (late cohorts 2/3 vs 1/2); bodies at the end 13 vs 11. E's heredity readouts: 16 mutations, 16 of 16 kind changes along tracks at a logged mutation, 0 off-kind daughters of 53; passers have 2.0 descendants two cycles later against 1.82 for non-passers (k1, n=2 vs 11).

observations.H: E_s504/stats.txt: 16/16 kind changes at logged mutations, 0 of 53 daughters off-kind; pool.txt: E minus twin trait_late -0.2, trait_end +4.8, pass share -0.015

seeds_run.result: capability not selected (replicates the negative); trait not selected over t >= 1000 (contradicts '4 of 4' for the late mean), higher only at T=2000

controls_run.H: twin_s504/ (identical-event twin, MARS 40/40/40, same seed and mutation and disc streams)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed with few dividing rods (14 and 19); the late trait-mean difference is now +7.6, +7.2, +3.4, +0.4 and -0.2 over five seeds, so trait selection in this environment is real on some seeds but not consistent, and the main conclusion (the environment does not select distance per cycle) stands. Reading the trait from rendered channels, as the author notes.
